metadata.owner_session: Bundle E session 2 v3 (ESCO-derived via skill-hierarchy transitive closure)
metadata.methodology: Built coordination skill set via transitive closure on ESCO broaderRelationsSkillPillar from {L1 'management skills', L1 'social and communication skills', L2 'advising and consulting', L2 'negotiating', L2 'presenting information', L2 'working with others', L2 'teaching and training', L2 'obtaining information verbally', L2 'liaising and networking', L2 'communication, collaboration and creativity'}. For each ESCO occupation, coordination-share = (essential skills in coordination cluster) / (total essential skills). Aggregated to ISCO-3-digit by arithmetic mean across occupations under each ISCO group.
metadata.uncertainty_band: ±0.05 on derived cells (uncertainty: choice of L2 under 'communication, collaboration and creativity' to include — I excluded 'writing and composing' / 'designing systems' / 'creating artistic' / 'performing' / 'solving problems' / 'using more than one language' as not-clearly-coordinative, but other reasonable choices exist). Default-fallback cells retain ±0.15 uncertainty.
metadata.country_scope_note: Coefficients are occupation-level (ISCO-3-digit), apply uniformly across all 36 countries.

previous_versions.v2: Attempted ESCO derivation but matched only top-level transversal-skill labels (zero hits because occupations link to leaf skills, not labels)
